content:
- When sentiment is positive (≥0.5) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤-0.5) in recent days, model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3-5 days), leading to overshoot; apply dampening factor to peak days.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in mean reversion — model takes 2-3 days to adjust to true trend; add 1-2 day lag correction.
- If sentiment shifts from negative to positive mid-horizon, model fails to adjust; re-estimate from sentiment pivot point.
- Avoid overfitting to recent high sentiment days — if sentiment peaks early, model often overcorrects later; use sentiment decay weighting.
